name: honda.com
body: Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But plain http serves the site without redirecting.
lesson: Redirect every http request to https with one permanent 301, then add HSTS.
summary: The site's bot protection refused the plain read and headless Chrome while it carried the review tag; the page was analyzed in headless Chrome without the tag. Partial analysis: 24 of 24 linked pages answered with a bot check or a block, so the scores rest mostly on the start page. www.honda.com scores 63 out of 100 (D). 7 checks fail now, 25 are at risk, and 21 pass. Fix first: tracking starts…

fix.title: Tracking starts before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: OneTrust was showing. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Ads (2 requests), and cookies __cf_bm on fonts.net, __Secure-YNID on youtube.com, YSC on youtube.com, __Secure-ROLLOUT_TOKEN on youtube.com, VISITOR_INFO1_LIVE on…
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Plain http serves the site without redirecting
fix.evidence: http:// answered 403. Visitors who type the address stay unencrypted.
fix.fix: Redirect every http request to https with a 301, then add HSTS.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 23 elements on /, for example .swiper-slide-visible > .swiper-slide__content > .swiper-slide__content--wrapper > .slider-cta-container > .btn-honda[da and .half[data-attribute="our-brands"] > h4. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: All touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 6 elements on /, for example span[aria-label="Go to slide 1"] and .swiper-pagination-bullet-active. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Make tap targets at least 24 by 24 px, or leave that much space around them.

fix.title: 10 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: Elements must only use permitted ARIA attributes
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 1 element on /, for example .search-trigger. Impact: serious.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Front-end libraries have no known flaw
The start page declares its language
The largest element paints in 0.8 s
Every page has a meta description
The start page sets a mobile viewport
